items.briefing:
Bitdefender has issued a warning about school-themed scams circulating across the Asia-Pacific region, including Australia. As the academic year progresses, cybercriminals are exploiting education-related topics to trick people into clicking malicious links or handing over personal information. Staff and students should be cautious about unexpected emails or messages related to enrolments, fees, or learning platforms.

Separately, security researchers continue to flag growing risks from AI-powered tools being misused to conduct automated attacks. As our organisation uses digital platforms daily, it's worth staying alert to phishing attempts that may appear more convincing than usual.

**Practical tip:** If you receive an unexpected email about fees, enrolments, or course access, verify it directly with the sender before clicking any links.
